definitions.explanation: A unit of measurement for engine power and mechanical output.
Used figuratively to describe a person's stamina, effort, or determination to get things done.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦エンジン→エンジン：03835_enjin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧200{馬力|ばりき}⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{馬力|ばりき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ほしい。
examples.english: I want a car with high horsepower.

examples.japanese: ⟦{軽自動車|けいじどうしゃ}→軽自動車：14298_keijidousha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{馬力|ばりき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{坂道|さかみち}→坂道：08166_sakamichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦きつい→きつい：02342_kitsui⟧。
examples.english: Light cars have low horsepower, so hills are tough.

examples.japanese: ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{馬力|ばりき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work with full steam before a deadline.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの{人|ひと}→あの人：25922_anohito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{馬力|ばりき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: That person has a lot of energy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧あと⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、{馬力|ばりき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}しよう→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
examples.english: There's only one week until the exam, so let's study with full force.

notes:
{馬力|ばりき} has both a technical meaning (horsepower as a unit) and a figurative meaning (personal energy and drive).

FORMS:
{馬|ば} (horse) + {力|りき} (power)

SENSE 1 — TECHNICAL:
Used as a unit of engine/motor power, equivalent to English "horsepower" (HP).
- 200{馬力|ばりき} (200 horsepower)
- {馬力|ばりき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧ (a high-horsepower car)

SENSE 2 — FIGURATIVE:
Very common in everyday conversation to describe energy and effort.
- {馬力|ばりき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ (to go full steam, put in full effort)
- {馬力|ばりき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have great energy/stamina)

USAGE:
The figurative sense is more frequently heard than the technical one. {馬力|ばりき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ is idiomatic and does not literally relate to engines.
